# Module M-03: Settle a line whose code matches nothing

## Lesson

You do this when a line stops on the exceptions list with an unknown code. When it works, the line is on the exceptions list with the code and the customer, and not in the order sheet. [SC-03]

## Exercise

In the test environment, with its test data:

1. Open the orders mailbox and find the purchase order with the unknown code. [SC-03 step 1]
2. Open the exceptions list and find the line with the code and the customer. [SC-03 step 2]

## Check question

What do you do when it goes wrong?

## Answer

Never guess a code; correct it only when the item list has it. [map/future.md item 2]
